Preserve all accepted requirements, the actual product visits, the fixed workbook write and unconditional browser cleanup. This is an explicit implementation revision before execution: compilation alone does not make the current adaptation safe. Review found whole raw snapshots sent to interpret_initial_page and interpret_search_ready; extract_first_products is whole-snapshot extraction that also selects ten products and manufactures originalIndex; extract_product_details is also whole-snapshot extraction. These are not compatible bounded independent adaptations.
Use existing bindings only. Known typed fields must use deterministic selections/assemblies; pure original-index copies may use foreach with index (compact-bindings-v3 compiles them without per-record workflow invocations). Prefer authoritative observed identities when available. Keep complete original snapshots and action data separately. For insufficiently typed extraction, explicitly use each over the complete snapshot's bounded pages, not the flattened record array. Every page must be processed; emit only the required consumer facts/candidates as nested arrays, then explicitly flatten exactly one level. The host each/ordinary-loop limit is 1000; declaring maxItems 10000 does not authorize 10000 iterations. Do not auto-chunk or truncate.
Business selection stays in explicit global interpret on the compact complete decision view; select observed IDs only, then use lookup to verify those IDs against offered candidates and reconnect to original observed URLs/references/actions. Preserve repetitions/order and nullable guards. Extraction must not rank, select the first ten, manufacture positional IDs, statuses, booleans or absent business facts. Use explicit interpretation for business decisions, including blocked/missing-data reporting; observed nullable facts remain nullable. An oversized necessary view remains a failure. Use complete observations with success/completeness guards before actions, observe again after consent, and use the producer's action compatibility checks. Product visits remain real operations, at most ten, followed by bounded per-page observed detail extraction and the existing explicit workbook formatting/write. Keep all guards and exports valid and preserve cleanup. Do not return scripts, invent tool fields or remove work to compile. No increase in runtime or inference limits.

command.text:
This is an explicit full implementation revision, not an answer granting broader repair slots. Preserve every accepted requirement and all actual navigation, workbook writing and cleanup operations. Resolve the two diagnosed defects with the existing TaskPlan constructs; no host permission or budget changes.
1. lookup operand order is exactly items:[typedRecords,selectedIds], with port naming the identity field. The current lookup_selected_products has these reversed. Global decisions receive an explicitly projected compact view (id plus needed observed text/facts); exclude duplicate IDs, action URLs/references and unrelated fields from that view, while retaining authoritative action records separately. Here "exclude duplicate IDs" means do not duplicate the same identity under multiple field names in the decision record; do NOT deduplicate candidates or selections. Selected-ID repeats are valid. Validate selected IDs against the offered view, then reconnect to retained action records with the same lookup binding. The extraction resultType is authoritative; no synthesized IDs or unobserved scalars.
2. open_product_page exports incompatible whole objects. Instead explicitly export the same typed interface from both branches: productPages (the observed snapshot.pages when navigation succeeds, an explicitly empty array when no URL exists), productVisited (true only after verified successful navigation; false on the missing-URL path), plus the explicit missing-URL reason if needed. Guard actual snapshot success/completeness before extracting pages. The missing-URL branch is truthful absence of navigation, not a complete acquired snapshot; later interpretation must report that missing observation and must not create successful detail data. The bounded page extraction consumes this explicit array port, not field observationSnapshot on a union of unrelated envelopes. Preserve meaningful branch conditions and matching nullability; do not cast or widen types.
Keep extraction each over bounded complete pages (maximum 100), not a 1602-record flat array (host each/loop ceiling 1000). Every page and nested candidate must be processed. Typed copying/index attachment stays deterministic; use declared source.reference as identity where present and never manufacture an originalIndex in learned mapping. Independent extraction produces observed facts only, with compact consumer views; blocked/missing-data status and business selection remain explicit interpretation. No whole raw snapshot or unnecessary URL collection enters global interpretation. Keep exact original action data and use valid null guards. Keep product visits capped at ten, the actual write_products_xlsx and close_browser_always, including workbookPath from the writer's real result. The requested correction cannot drop work, return a path literal, fabricate completeness, raise limits or reset cumulative accounting.

Explicit implementation revision preserving the current complete plan and all accepted requirements. Make only these binding corrections; do not redesign the workflow or alter operations, result contracts, objectives, ordering, branch interfaces, write_products_xlsx or cleanup.
- extract_search_result_pages.each.output must be exactly "pageProductCandidates", its existing sole nonnullable array result field. It currently incorrectly says "pageProductExtraction". Keep each.input="page" and the resultType unchanged.
- project_product_decision_view is a foreach exporting the named collection port "decisionCandidate". In lookup_selected_decision_records's first lookup operand and interpret_product_selection's offeredCandidates input, use {kind:"output",source:"project_product_decision_view",port:"decisionCandidate"}. The current null port is the whole object envelope, not typed records. Keep lookup(port:"id",items:[records,selectedIds]) order and repeated-ID semantics unchanged.
- Likewise, prepare_excel_tsv must consume visit_each_product's explicit productRow collection port, rather than its whole output envelope. Preserve all bounded-page extraction, explicit flattening, compact decision fields, retained original action records and ID reconnection. Do not add scripts, manufacture IDs, omit candidates, reset budgets, raise limits or replace an external result with a literal.
All other work stays unchanged. This is the last available call under the original eight-call planning ceiling; if a truthful valid plan cannot be produced, retain the limitation rather than bypass checks.
